title: Monthly Cohort Retention – First Watch Match
prompt: A streaming platform wants to measure month-over-month retention. Write a query that returns, for each user, their `user_id`, `signup_month` (the month and year they signed up, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-01'), and a boolean column `watched_in_signup_month` indicating whether the user watched at least one video during the same calendar month they signed up. A user 'watched in their signup month' if the month-and-year of at least one of their `watched_at` timestamps matches the month-and-year of their `signup_ts`. Use `DATE_TRUNC('month', ...)::date` to bucket both the signup timestamp and the watch timestamp into monthly cohorts, then check for a match. The final result should include every user in the `users` table (even those with zero watches). Output columns: `user_id`, `signup_month`, `watched_in_signup_month`. Order by `user_id` ascending.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE users (user_id INT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT NOT NULL, signup_ts TIMESTAMP NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE video_watches (watch_id INT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT NOT NULL, video_id INT NOT NULL, watched_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL);

composite_moves: DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_ts) to extract signup_month cohort
DATE_TRUNC('month', watched_at) to extract watch month cohort
Check if watch month = signup month for any watch
Aggregate per user with BOOL_OR or COUNT DISTINCT to set watched_in_signup_month flag
COALESCE false for users with no watches

hints: Use DATE_TRUNC('month', timestamp_column)::date to bucket a timestamp into its calendar month as a date.
You need to compare the month bucket of signup_ts with the month bucket of watched_at for each watch. A LEFT JOIN from users to video_watches will preserve users with zero watches.

After joining, group by user_id and signup_month, then use BOOL_OR(DATE_TRUNC('month', watched_at)::date = DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_ts)::date) to check if any watch fell in the signup month. COALESCE the result to false for users with no watches.
answer_key: SELECT u.user_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', u.signup_ts)::date AS signup_month, COALESCE(BOOL_OR(DATE_TRUNC('month', vw.watched_at)::date = DATE_TRUNC('month', u.signup_ts)::date), false) AS watched_in_signup_month FROM users u LEFT JOIN video_watches vw ON u.user_id = vw.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.signup_ts ORDER BY u.user_id;

_meta.scenario: a streaming platform tracking content views, completion rates, and ratings
